Legend
━━ red: censorship-resistant leg (VLESS+REALITY, TCP 443)
━━ green: WireGuard tunnel (home initiates outbound)
━━ gray: plain Internet egress
Key idea: VPS only relays. The home server is the exit,
so the public-facing source IP is your residential IP.
